t.E290.agn: In 1985 JECFA evaluated the acceptable daily intake (ADI) for carbon dioxide as 'not specified'; the functions listed by JECFA include carbonating agent, propellant, preservative, freezant and extraction solvent. In 2023 EFSA published a call for data for the re-evaluation of gaseous additives, including carbon dioxide.
t.E290.found.0: May be used in many foods in the EU at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E290.prod: Collected as a by-product of fermentation, from natural sources or from industrial processes.
t.E290.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E290.regx.2: A call for data for the re-evaluation of gaseous additives was published in 2023 (deadline 31 March 2024).
t.E290.summary: Carbon dioxide gas. It gives fizz to carbonated drinks, replaces air in packaging and plays a role in leavening.
t.E290.what: It is a gas that gives food fizz (carbonation), creates a protective atmosphere in packaging and is used as a propellant.
